hooks.name: cgameui_created
hooks.cache_source: CGameUI ctor/factory stores the new singleton at 0x6FD6A8B8

hooks.name: cgameui_seen
hooks.cache_source: CGameUI::Get rewrites the same singleton; only ecx == 0 is a clear

hooks.name: cgameui_destroyed
hooks.cache_source: CGameUI teardown clears the singleton after the field-clear loop

hooks.name: gameover_cleared
hooks.cache_source: CGameUI teardown clears CGameUI+0x22C with a constant zero

hooks.name: cinematic_enter_timed
hooks.cache_source: ShowInterface(false, duration > 0) writes CGameUI+0x180 = 1 and shows CCinematicPanel

hooks.name: cinematic_enter_instant
hooks.cache_source: ShowInterface(false, duration <= 0) writes CGameUI+0x180 = 3 and shows CCinematicPanel

hooks.name: cinematic_leave_timed
hooks.cache_source: ShowInterface(true, duration > 0) writes CGameUI+0x180 = 2 and restores the interface

hooks.name: cinematic_leave_instant
hooks.cache_source: ShowInterface(true, duration <= 0) writes CGameUI+0x180 = 4 and restores the interface

hooks.name: interface_timed_complete
hooks.cache_source: Timer 0x1E callback completes a timed ShowInterface: writes CGameUI+0x180 = 4 when a timed show completes (interface visible again, so the cinematic bit is cleared) or 3 when a timed hide completes (interface stays hidden, which is the cinematic mode, so the cinematic bit is kept); the published value selects the meaning
